seed_variation.verdict: Only one seed was run, so there is no seed variation to measure.
seed_variation.why: A hosted LLM cannot be seeded: our seeds only reach local random generators, and the provider's sampling (temperature etc.) is fixed for this model. So every run can give different text, and the spread across seeds measures the model's own run-to-run variation. Each seed repeats every API call. Each seed sets Python random, NumPy and torch. PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed to the FIRST seed for the whole run.

predictions.SY0110c: The team convened for their third conceptual design meeting. predictions.SY0110d: The team proceeded with the ten-thousand-unit order and agreed to cover losses via a monthly partner fee. Marketing Expert presented the tested staff guide, and Industrial Designer and Project Manager agreed to laminate the guides. Industrial Designer walked through the final cup specifications of three hundred millilitres, polypropylene, a ninety-millimetre rim, a ribbed band, and slate grey colour with an in-mould logo, and added that 'return for one euro' would be embossed on the base. Project Manager noted the window badge design is basically final and will ask Jonas to prepare the print file once he recovers. Finally, the team reviewed management's requirements, confirming that the cup is dishwasher-safe, fits standard lids, and costs one fifty-four to produce, while Marketing Expert agreed to contact fifty cafes from the trade fair list, and Project Manager will write the final report and meeting minutes.

Tomasz reviewed survey responses to establish six evaluation criteria, which the team scored from one to seven, and a proposal to add a shoulder strap was rejected due to safety risks and added cost.
